scene.title: Photosynthesis Overview
scene.summary: Sunlight powers the leaf to turn water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.

beats.title: Sunlight reaches leaf
beats.narration: Sunlight shines onto the leaf, providing the energy needed for photosynthesis.

beats.title: Chloroplast captures light
beats.narration: Chloroplasts inside the leaf absorb the light and start the chemical process.

beats.title: Glucose and oxygen formed
beats.narration: The leaf creates glucose for energy storage and releases oxygen as a by‑product.

beats.title: Recap of photosynthesis
beats.narration: Sunlight + H₂O + CO₂ → C₆H₁₂O₆ + O₂. The leaf captures light, uses water and carbon dioxide, and outputs glucose and oxygen.
